name: Markdown
summary: A bounded and filtered Markdown renderer.

obligations: Remove raw HTML and unsafe URLs.

behavior: Raw block and inline HTML are dropped.
Only HTTP(S) and mailto links, plus HTTP(S) images, are emitted.
A link whose URL is not allowed renders as its text only, and an image whose URL is not allowed renders as its alt text.
Without baseUrl, relative links and images are not allowed.
A link to a fragment in the same document, such as #summary, is allowed with or without baseUrl; an image URL that is only a fragment is not.
With baseUrl, relative links and images resolve against it, and absolute URLs are kept as written.
baseUrl must be an absolute HTTP(S) URL without a username or password.
An invalid baseUrl, including an empty string, replaces the whole content with invalidFallback and sets data-markdown-error to MARKDOWN_INVALID_BASE_URL.
invalidFallback is any React node and defaults to the text Content unavailable.
invalidFallback also replaces content that fails another limit, with a different data-markdown-error code.
Indented code tokens retain paragraph semantics while fenced tokens render code blocks.
Parsed source is bounded to 100k characters, 10k lines, depth 32, and 10k nodes.

requirements.reason: Native colors do not apply to web React.
Native font metrics do not apply to web React.
